views.name: v_cart_totals
views.definition:
SELECT c.cart_id,
    c.customer_subject,
    c.revision,
    (COALESCE(sum((b.current_price * (i.quantity)::numeric)) FILTER (WHERE (i.kind = 'PURCHASE'::text)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(19,2) AS subtotal,
    round((COALESCE(sum((b.current_price * (i.quantity)::numeric)) FILTER (WHERE (i.kind = 'PURCHASE'::text)), (0)::numeric) * 0.10), 2) AS tax,
    (COALESCE(sum((b.current_price * (i.quantity)::numeric)) FILTER (WHERE (i.kind = 'PURCHASE'::text)), (0)::numeric) + round((COALESCE(sum((b.current_price * (i.quantity)::numeric)) FILTER (WHERE (i.kind = 'PURCHASE'::text)), (0)::numeric) * 0.10), 2)) AS total
   FROM ((cart c
     LEFT JOIN cart_item i USING (cart_id))
     LEFT JOIN book b USING (book_id))
  GROUP BY c.cart_id;

views.name: v_inventory
views.definition:
SELECT b.book_id,
    b.title,
    b.author,
    b.isbn,
    b.publisher_id,
    b.publisher_kind,
    b.book_type_id,
    b.book_type_kind,
    b.genre_id,
    b.genre_kind,
    b.condition_id,
    b.condition_kind,
    b.current_price,
    b.description,
    b.cover_url,
    b.unlisted,
    r.purchase_cost,
    r.source_offer_id,
    r.recorded_at AS registered_at,
    s.available,
    (s.available = 0) AS out_of_stock,
    (s.available <= 5) AS low_in_stock
   FROM ((book b
     JOIN book_receipt r USING (book_id))
     JOIN stock_balance s USING (book_id));

views.name: v_model_issues
views.definition:
WITH differences AS (
         SELECT 'stock_cache'::text AS issue,
            (COALESCE(f.book_id, c.book_id))::text AS entity
           FROM (v_stock_fact_balance f
             FULL JOIN stock_balance c USING (book_id))
          WHERE ((c.book_id IS NULL) OR (f.book_id IS NULL) OR ((f.head_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM c.head_sequence) OR (f.available IS DISTINCT FROM c.available)))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'order_cache'::text,
            (COALESCE(f.order_id, c.order_id))::text AS "coalesce"
           FROM (v_order_fact_state f
             FULL JOIN order_state c USING (order_id))
          WHERE ((c.order_id IS NULL) OR (f.order_id IS NULL) OR ((f.head_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM c.head_sequence) OR (f.status IS DISTINCT FROM c.status)))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'offer_cache'::text,
            (COALESCE(f.offer_id, c.offer_id))::text AS "coalesce"
           FROM (v_offer_fact_state f
             FULL JOIN offer_state c USING (offer_id))
          WHERE ((c.offer_id IS NULL) OR (f.offer_id IS NULL) OR (((f.head_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM c.head_sequence) OR (f.status IS DISTINCT FROM c.status)) OR (f.stocked IS DISTINCT FROM c.stocked)))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'stock_chain'::text,
            (m.book_id)::text AS book_id
           FROM (stock_movement m
             JOIN stock_movement p ON (((p.book_id = m.book_id) AND (p.sequence_no = m.previous_sequence))))
          WHERE (m.quantity_before <> p.quantity_after)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'order_transition'::text,
            (e.order_id)::text AS order_id
           FROM (order_event e
             JOIN order_event p ON (((p.order_id = e.order_id) AND (p.sequence_no = e.previous_sequence))))
          WHERE ((((((p.kind <> 'PLACED'::text) OR (e.kind <> 'ACCEPTED'::text)) AND ((p.kind <> 'PLACED'::text) OR (e.kind <> 'CANCELLED'::text))) AND ((p.kind <> 'ACCEPTED'::text) OR (e.kind <> 'SHIPPED'::text))) AND ((p.kind <> 'ACCEPTED'::text) OR (e.kind <> 'CANCELLED'::text))) AND ((p.kind <> 'SHIPPED'::text) OR (e.kind <> 'DELIVERED'::text)))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'offer_transition'::text,
            (e.offer_id)::text AS offer_id
           FROM (offer_event e
             JOIN offer_event p ON (((p.offer_id = e.offer_id) AND (p.sequence_no = e.previous_sequence))))
          WHERE ((((((((p.kind <> 'SUBMITTED'::text) OR (e.kind <> 'APPROVED'::text)) AND ((p.kind <> 'SUBMITTED'::text) OR (e.kind <> 'REJECTED'::text))) AND ((p.kind <> 'SUBMITTED'::text) OR (e.kind <> 'WITHDRAWN'::text))) AND ((p.kind <> 'APPROVED'::text) OR (e.kind <> 'RECEIVED'::text))) AND ((p.kind <> 'RECEIVED'::text) OR (e.kind <> 'PAID'::text))) AND ((p.kind <> 'RECEIVED'::text) OR (e.kind <> 'REJECTED'::text))) AND ((p.kind <> 'PAID'::text) OR (e.kind <> 'STOCKED'::text)))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'order_amount_or_empty'::text,
            (o.order_id)::text AS order_id
           FROM (sales_order o
             LEFT JOIN order_item i USING (order_id))
          GROUP BY o.order_id
         HAVING ((count(i.book_id) = 0) OR (o.subtotal <> sum(((i.quantity)::numeric * i.frozen_price))))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'book_receipt_missing'::text,
            (b.book_id)::text AS book_id
           FROM ((book b
             LEFT JOIN book_receipt r USING (book_id))
             LEFT JOIN stock_movement m ON (((m.book_id = b.book_id) AND (m.sequence_no = 1))))
          WHERE ((r.book_id IS NULL) OR (m.book_id IS NULL) OR (r.initial_quantity <> m.quantity_after) OR ((r.source_offer_id IS NULL) AND (m.kind <> 'REGISTERED'::text)) OR ((r.source_offer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (m.kind <> 'SHELVED'::text)))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'order_root_missing'::text,
            (o.order_id)::text AS order_id
           FROM (sales_order o
             LEFT JOIN order_event e ON (((e.order_id = o.order_id) AND (e.sequence_no = 1))))
          WHERE ((e.order_id IS NULL) OR (e.occurred_at <> o.ordered_at))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'offer_root_missing'::text,
            (o.offer_id)::text AS offer_id
           FROM (offer o
             LEFT JOIN offer_event e ON (((e.offer_id = o.offer_id) AND (e.sequence_no = 1))))
          WHERE ((e.offer_id IS NULL) OR (e.occurred_at <> o.submitted_at))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'stock_order_effect'::text,
            (((i.order_id)::text || ':'::text) || (i.book_id)::text)
           FROM order_item i
          WHERE ((NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM stock_movement m
                  WHERE ((m.order_id = i.order_id) AND (m.book_id = i.book_id) AND (m.kind = 'ORDERED'::text) AND (m.quantity_delta = (- i.quantity)))))) OR ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM order_event e
                  WHERE ((e.order_id = i.order_id) AND (e.kind = 'CANCELLED'::text)))) IS DISTINCT FROM (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM stock_movement m
                  WHERE ((m.order_id = i.order_id) AND (m.book_id = i.book_id) AND (m.kind = 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (m.quantity_delta = i.quantity))))))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'shelving_contract'::text,
            (r.book_id)::text AS book_id
           FROM (book_receipt r
             JOIN offer o ON ((o.offer_id = r.source_offer_id)))
          WHERE ((r.purchase_cost <> o.offered_price) OR (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM offer_event e
                  WHERE ((e.offer_id = o.offer_id) AND (e.kind = 'PAID'::text))))) OR (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM offer_event e
                  WHERE ((e.offer_id = o.offer_id) AND (e.kind = 'STOCKED'::text))))))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'stocked_book_missing'::text,
            (e.offer_id)::text AS offer_id
           FROM offer_event e
          WHERE ((e.kind = 'STOCKED'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM book_receipt r
                  WHERE (r.source_offer_id = e.offer_id)))))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'movement_event_kind'::text,
            (m.book_id)::text AS book_id
           FROM (stock_movement m
             JOIN order_event e ON (((e.order_id = m.order_id) AND (e.sequence_no = m.order_event_sequence))))
          WHERE (((m.kind = 'ORDERED'::text) AND (e.kind <> 'PLACED'::text)) OR ((m.kind = 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (e.kind <> 'CANCELLED'::text)))
        )
 SELECT issue,
    entity
   FROM differences;

views.name: v_offer_fact_state
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (offer_id) offer_id,
    sequence_no AS head_sequence,
        CASE kind
            WHEN 'SUBMITTED'::text THEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::text
            WHEN 'STOCKED'::text THEN 'PAID'::text
            ELSE kind
        END AS status,
    (kind = 'STOCKED'::text) AS stocked
   FROM offer_event
  ORDER BY offer_id, sequence_no DESC;

views.name: v_order_fact_state
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (order_id) order_id,
    sequence_no AS head_sequence,
        CASE kind
            WHEN 'PLACED'::text THEN 'PENDING'::text
            WHEN 'ACCEPTED'::text THEN 'ORDERED'::text
            ELSE kind
        END AS status
   FROM order_event
  ORDER BY order_id, sequence_no DESC;

views.name: v_order_summary
views.definition:
SELECT o.order_id,
    o.order_number,
    o.customer_subject,
    o.source_address_id,
    o.ship_line1,
    o.ship_line2,
    o.ship_city,
    o.ship_state_code,
    o.ship_postal_code,
    o.ship_country_code,
    o.ordered_at,
    o.delivery_due_date,
    o.subtotal,
    o.tax_rate,
    o.tax,
    o.total,
    s.status,
    ( SELECT sum((i.frozen_cost * (i.quantity)::numeric)) AS sum
           FROM order_item i
          WHERE (i.order_id = o.order_id)) AS cost,
    (o.subtotal - ( SELECT sum((i.frozen_cost * (i.quantity)::numeric)) AS sum
           FROM order_item i
          WHERE (i.order_id = o.order_id))) AS gross_profit
   FROM (sales_order o
     JOIN order_state s USING (order_id));

views.name: v_paid_offer
views.definition:
SELECT o.offer_id,
    o.customer_subject,
    o.title,
    o.author,
    o.isbn,
    o.publisher_id,
    o.publisher_kind,
    o.book_type_id,
    o.book_type_kind,
    o.genre_id,
    o.genre_kind,
    o.condition_id,
    o.condition_kind,
    o.description,
    o.offered_price,
    o.submitted_at,
    e.occurred_at AS paid_at
   FROM (offer o
     JOIN offer_event e USING (offer_id))
  WHERE (e.kind = 'PAID'::text);

views.name: v_stock_fact_balance
views.definition:
SELECT book_id,
    max(sequence_no) AS head_sequence,
    (sum(quantity_delta))::integer AS available
   FROM stock_movement
  GROUP BY book_id;
